sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Jewel Royal Saga's core gameplay revolves around matching jewels in a grid, clearing obstacles, and unlocking new levels. The game's mechanics are simple yet engaging, making it an ideal game for players of all ages and skill levels. One of the key mechanics in Jewel Royal Saga is the concept of combos, where players can match three or more jewels in a row to earn bonus points and rewards.

The game also features a variety of power-ups and special items that can be used to aid players in their progress. These power-ups can be activated to clear obstacles, boost scores, or even freeze time.
